draft.subject: Your question about inviting a teammate
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for flagging this in your ticket about adding your teammate; sorry it held you up. In Wrenfield, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you have several to add.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through it with you.

Best,
Chidi
